text:
reza: Flagging Solstice Analytics (acct SA-701)  usage down ~60% last 14 days. Renewal in 10 days. Customer signal: considering downgrade to Standard. Need rapid save plan and downgrade-path playbook prepared.

marta: Oof. ARR? who owns renewal?

reza: $54k ARR, Dedicated -> Hosted trial last quarter. Renewal owner is julia@solstice.io. Primary pain: inference cost spikes and unclear ROI from recommendations endpoint.

chris: Any active incidents or SLO breaches?

reza: No SLOs breached. Support ticket SUP-782 about inconsistent top-k results from reranker. NPS 5 two months ago. They missed the last two enablement syncs.

ejan: (typo) evan: I can do a quick cost/usage baseline and simulate downgrade impact across their key endpoints.

marta: Good. Proposed approach: 1) immediate outreach + short feedback capture survey, 2) technical health call within 48h, 3) run prompt & token audit, 4) offer runbook: either a targeted optimization (keep tier) or a graceful downgrade path with feature mapping and migration checklist.

reza: Draft checklist below  please assign owners.

```
- outreach email w/ 3-question feedback survey (owner: julia, within 12h)
- 45m joint technical + product health call (owner: chris)
- prompt/token audit + top-3 token-savers (owner: evan)
- quick demo of cost delta: current vs optimized config vs downgrade (owner: evan)
- prepare downgrade mapping doc: list of endpoints/features impacted and recommended config changes + rollback steps (owner: marta)
- offer: conditional 30d credits if they accept a remediation run (owner: julia)
- escalation: if no reply in 48h, escalate to CSM lead and open a retention task (owner: reza)
```

chris: I'll take the call prep & run a small A/B to show before/after batching and cache impact. Will bring a sample config diff and token estimates.

evan: Running query now to pull top token sinks. Sample query I'll run: 
```
SELECT endpoint, count(*) as calls, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM usage.events WHERE account='SA-701' AND ts>now()-14d GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;
```

julia: I'll send the outreach and cc their CTO. I'll include an exec one-pager with two tracks: Optimize (recommended) and Downgrade (if they insist) with clear feature tradeoffs.

marta: For downgrade doc: include a migration checklist, sample API keys segregation, rate-limit adjustments, and an automated config shim we can provide to make the switch reversible. Also include estimated cost runway numbers.

cse_bot: Account snapshot added: https://redwood.app/account/SA-701/health | onboarding 48/100, last enablement 55d ago, NPS=5. Save-play artifact created and linked.

reza: Owners assigned. Please update this thread with meeting link and artifacts. If we secure the health call and show <20% token reduction risk, we pause downgrade.

ejan: evan: Posting initial audit by EOD with token-saver estimates and a sample config diff.

julia: Outreach sent. Meeting scheduled: Thu 9am PT. I'll post the one-pager before the call.

chris: Adding a short demo: before/after p90 latency and token cost. If they lean downgrade, we'll show a reversible shim and migration timeline (2-3 days).

reza: Thanks team 44d Marking as 'priority retention' and setting follow-up reminder in 48h.

cse_bot: Reminder created: follow-up thread ping in 48h if no engagement.
